# Cornell Duffield Hall Engineering

> > Cornell Duffield Hall Engineering showcases cutting-edge research, faculty achievements, and student programs across materials science, soft matter physics, climate science, and biomedical engineering.

This site highlights research breakthroughs and academic achievements from Cornell University's engineering programs, featuring work published in Nature Communications and covered by Cornell Chronicle. The site emphasizes interdisciplinary research in materials science, sustainable energy, biomedical innovation, and student entrepreneurship programs like the Kessler Fellows.

## Key Topics

- Cornell Engineering
- Materials Science & Engineering
- Soft Matter Physics
- Climate Research
- Biomedical Engineering
- Dialytaxis and Marangoni Effects
- Protein Condensates
- Green Hydrogen Production
- Metal Bonding Mechanisms
- Kessler Fellows Program
- Health Hackathon
- Faculty Awards and Recognition
- Nature Communications Research
- Entrepreneurship and Innovation
- Laboratory of Soft and Living Materials

## Research Breakthroughs

- [Droplets swim to dissolution, could inspire fluid microbots](https://www.duffield.cornell.edu/droplets-swim-to-dissolution-could-inspire-fluid-microbots): Research on protein condensate droplet swimming via dialytaxis effect
- [Supersonic microprojectiles reveal new insights into metal bonding](https://www.duffield.cornell.edu/supersonic-microprojectiles-reveal-new-insights-into-metal-bonding): Research reveals metal bonding mechanisms via high-speed collisions
- [Green hydrogen study highlights strategies for offshore production](https://www.duffield.cornell.edu/green-hydrogen-study-highlights-strategies-for-offshore-production): Fengqi You's study on offshore wind-powered hydrogen production strategies

## Faculty Recognition and Awards

- [Mahowald honored by AMS with climate research award](https://www.duffield.cornell.edu/mahowald-honored-by-ams-with-climate-research-award): Natalie Mahowald receives Syukuro Manabe Climate Research Award from AMS
- [Rand receives Hartog Award](https://www.duffield.cornell.edu/rand-receives-hartog-award): Richard Rand receives ASME J.P. Den Hartog Award for vibration engineering

## Student Programs and Achievements

- [2024 Kessler Fellows embark on summer internships](https://www.duffield.cornell.edu/2024-kessler-fellows-embark-on-summer-internships): 2024 Kessler Fellows pursue entrepreneurial internships at global startups
- [BBS Ph.D. candidate wins 2025 3MT competition](https://www.duffield.cornell.edu/bbs-ph-d-candidate-wins-2025-3mt-competition): Sydney Womack wins Three Minute Thesis competition with osteoarthritis research
- [Students from 29 campuses join forces for health hackathon](https://www.duffield.cornell.edu/students-from-29-campuses-join-forces-for-health-hackathon): Multi-campus Health Hackathon tackles patient safety challenges
- [Students and alumni honored at tenth annual Distinguished Awards Gala](https://www.duffield.cornell.edu/students-alumni-honored-tenth-annual-distinguished-awards-gala): Materials Science & Engineering Distinguished Awards Gala honors students
